by: interests-expenses session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at interests-expenses-1)
title: The Register of Pecuniary and Other Specified Interests of Members of Parliament: Summary of annual returns (J.7)
applies_to: Each annual edition of the register's summary, 2006 to 2026 held, as PDFs Arthur downloaded by hand into the old folder's var/mp_interests/ (mp-<year>.pdf). Published on www3.parliament.nz under MPs' financial interests.

landmarks: a title page: 'Register of Pecuniary [and Other Specified] Interests of Members of Parliament: Summary of annual returns as at 31 January <year>'
an introduction listing the categories by number and heading (13 to 2017, 14 from 2018)
member headers 'Name (Party, Electorate)' at the margin, each followed by numbered category lines
after the last member, a heading for the reprinted rules ('Annex …', 'Appendix B', 'STANDING ORDERS—APPENDIX B')

signals.text_layer: every page that carries a member

signals_note: Recognised by shape: a PDF of 58 to 80 pages with a text layer throughout (pages 2 of 2021, 2025 and 2026 are blank versos), the J.7 paper number in its running head. The member headers and the annex heading are landmarks of the layout, measured without reading a declaration.

tables.members: a header 'Name (Party, Electorate)'; an independent may be printed 'Name (Electorate)', sometimes with a footnote mark; a nickname may sit in brackets inside the name
tables.categories: 'N   Heading' lines; the heading, never the number, says the category: the register renumbered in 2018 (Managed investment schemes inserted at 8), so 9 is Creditors to 2017 and Debtors (later 'Debts owed to you') from 2018
tables.declarations: one per line beneath its category, indented; a long one wraps onto a line starting lower-case or closing a bracket the line above opened
tables.statements: 'No interests declared under the categories …' or 'Return not received by due date' in place of categories

notes: Measured over the 21 held editions on 20 October 2026: 2,526 returns and 24,931 declarations, every heading wording mapped (23 wordings, 14 categories), and in every edition every number the returns file under carries, by its heading, the category the edition's own introduction gives that number. Every edition reprints the rules after the last member, and their clause numbers look exactly like category lines: the reading stops at the annex heading after the last member header. A running head ('J. 7  REGISTER OF PECUNIARY …') and page numbers are dropped. A page footnote on a low-interest debt ('* Interest rate payable …') is not a declaration. Declarations under Real property can place a member's home (suburb, town) and are held in the private schema. The old estate's parser missed minor-party and independent headers (Māori Party, United Future, Progressive, Mana, independents) and filed their declarations under the member before; this profile's reading does not.
process: Read the text layer page by page.
Take the edition's date from its title page and its category list from its introduction.
Cut the annex at its heading after the last member.
File each declaration by its heading's category; keep the printed number as an attribute.
Find every declaration verbatim in the edition's own text.
gates: Every heading wording is in the lane's map; an unseen wording is a catch-log line, never guessed.
Every declaration is found verbatim in the edition's text, or it is set aside.
Every number the returns file under agrees, by heading, with the edition's own introduction (the outside check).
on_fail: set aside the declaration or the line; publish the rest
